title: Translator search data v1 (inside the agent result envelope)

enum.name: catalog
enum.summary: Return this offline command catalog; no runtime or files are required.

arguments.name: --command
arguments.description: Return only one command definition to reduce agent context.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: search
enum.summary: Primary agent entry: retrieve command summaries and exact specifications for a Japanese or English goal, offline. Retrieval never executes a command.

arguments.name: --query
arguments.description: One natural-language goal or an exact command name; 1–1024 characters, no credentials.

arguments.name: --limit
arguments.description: Maximum retrieved command or limitation cards. Check retrieval status before choosing.

examples: translator agent search --query "アプリを起動したい"

retry.guidance: Read-only offline retrieval; rephrase an ambiguous or unmatched goal before any execution.

enum.name: status
enum.summary: Discover the runtime. Missing runtime succeeds with running:false. Running status includes settings, session metadata and caption_count, without transcript text.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: runtime-start
enum.summary: Start a detached runtime without opening a browser or starting a session/audio. Source startup may build missing assets.

arguments.name: --timeout
arguments.description: Maximum readiness wait in seconds.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: runtime-stop
enum.summary: Request authenticated shutdown and wait for that runtime to stop.

arguments.name: --timeout
arguments.description: Maximum shutdown wait in seconds.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: settings-get
enum.summary: Read current preferences and provider configuration metadata; never return API keys.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: settings-set
enum.summary: Update preferences from {expected_revision:integer,settings:object}; maximum UTF-8 input size is 32768 bytes.

arguments.name: --input
arguments.description: UTF-8 input file path, or - to read stdin. Never pass a key in command arguments.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: session-create
enum.summary: Create an idle conversation; an explicit demo/live mode is required. This does not start capture or providers.

arguments.name: --translation-enabled
arguments.description: Requires an explicit value: --translation-enabled true or --translation-enabled false.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

examples: translator agent session-create --mode demo --source-language zh --target-language ja

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: session-start
enum.summary: Prepare an existing conversation. Demo starts synthetic PCM; live mode waits for a participant and does not capture the PC.

arguments.name: --session-id
arguments.description: Use the exact session_id returned by session-create or status.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: session-stop
enum.summary: Stop a conversation, release audio/providers and discard its in-memory captions.

arguments.name: --session-id
arguments.description: Use the exact session_id returned by session-create or status.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: session-snapshot
enum.summary: Read current conversation state and the latest captions (default10). caption_count is the total retained; captions_truncated reports omitted older entries.

arguments.name: --session-id
arguments.description: Use the exact session_id returned by session-create or status.

arguments.name: --limit
arguments.description: Maximum recent captions returned; use 1 for the newest utterance.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: invite-create
enum.summary: Return a sensitive, one-use, ten-minute participant invite URL. Share it only with the intended participant.

arguments.name: --session-id
arguments.description: Use the exact session_id returned by session-create or status.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: diagnostics
enum.summary: Read runtime diagnostics without API keys or transcript text.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: devices
enum.summary: Enumerate native PC audio output devices; this does not start capture.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: secret-set
enum.summary: Read a non-empty plaintext UTF-8 key from stdin/file, maximum 4096 bytes. Memory-only by default; never echo the key.

arguments.name: --provider
arguments.description: Provider to configure or test.

arguments.name: --input
arguments.description: UTF-8 input file path, or - to read stdin. Never pass a key in command arguments.

arguments.name: --persist
arguments.description: Presence-only flag: add --persist without a value to opt in to the OS credential store.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: provider-test
enum.summary: Explicitly contact the configured provider; usage may be incurred. ngrok validation is performed by tunnel-start.

arguments.name: --provider
arguments.description: Provider to configure or test.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: tunnel-start
enum.summary: Explicitly publish the participant Hub with the configured ngrok account and domain.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: tunnel-stop
enum.summary: Stop the currently owned public tunnel.

arguments.name: --request-id
arguments.description: Optional stable operation ID; generated when omitted. Never automatically retried.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.

enum.name: audio-share
enum.summary: Share the selected PC output for a bounded duration, keep the authenticated owner heartbeat alive, then stop owned capture.

arguments.name: --session-id
arguments.description: Use the exact session_id returned by session-create or status.

arguments.name: --device-id
arguments.description: Output device ID from devices; omit for the current OS default.

retry.guidance: Do not retry mutations automatically; inspect status after an uncertain response.
